description: This file contains unit tests for the PolicyEntriesModified class in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.policies package, verifying JSON serialization, immutability, equality, and constructor behavior.

classes.name: PolicyEntriesModifiedTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing PolicyEntriesModified's JSON serialization, equality, and constructor behaviors.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Confirms that PolicyEntriesModified instances are immutable and that their iterable entries are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the equals and hashCode implementations for PolicyEntriesModified.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyIdString
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with a null policy ID string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyId
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with a null PolicyId object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyEntries
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with null PolicyEntries throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toJson method produces the expected JSON structure.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Verifies that a PolicyEntriesModified instance can be created from valid JSON and its fields match expectations.
